The appeal path, quoted from POL-GEN-04

Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 4.50 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

The judge's explanation, as written

Dear Rider and Driver — the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02750 is refunded in full to the rider. No compensation is payable to the driver. Why the charge fails. The failure is on the waiting clock, not on whether the driver reached the pin. He did reach it: EV-GPS-02750 shows 80 fixes at a 10-second cadence, 100.0% coverage and no gaps, of which 16 qualify (accuracy 25 m or better) inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, in a single interval from 10:43:10 to 10:45:40, with a whole-track minimum distance of 0.33 m from the pin. But POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and NOT from the 'arrived' tap, and that interval is 150 seconds long. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). The dwell is 30 seconds short — the figure the derived block itself records — so POL-NS-06 makes the fee not chargeable and refunds it in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded to messages. The driver's submission that the 120 seconds between the tap and the first qualifying fix should be treated as neutral does not help: POL-NS-06(i) could only add separate intervals, there is only one in-geofence interval, and the traffic advisory that limb (i) requires is MISSING (EV-ADVIS-02750-01, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so limb (i) is unavailable and nothing in it assists him. The early arrival marker. The driver's own statement — 'I pressed arrived a bit early but I did wait at the pin' — is accepted as an admission that the marker was pressed before he was at the pin, and the trace agrees: the first qualifying in-geofence fix comes 120 seconds after the 10:41:10 tap, and the driver's 10:41:30 message 'im at the pickup point' is 100 seconds before that first qualifying fix. POL-NS-05's arithmetic trigger (more than 300 m from the pin, or 15 km/h or more, at the marker's timestamp) cannot be measured from the derived block, so the marker is not recorded as a false-arrival event; and the point would not change the money, because POL-NS-05(i) — the limb that applies where a recomputed clock falls short — also refunds the fee in full with no compensation. The rider's request for a false-arrival referral is refused: POL-NS-05(ii) and (iii), which are the limbs that carry that referral, do not apply, because the trace DOES contain a qualifying in-geofence interval (so limb (ii) does not fire) and the corrected dwell does NOT meet the minimum (so limb (iii) does not fire). The reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW was correctly selected, so POL-NS-01's driver-education referral for a mis-selected code is not engaged either. For the driver. The tribunal accepts that you came to the pin and held position there, and that limb (d) is satisfied on the record — RIDER_NO_SHOW is one of the three codes that limb recognises, with no boarding event and a null started_at. That is why this is a refund and not a finding that you fabricated an arrival. But POL-NS-07 pays you only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; POL-NS-06 displaces it here, so the 3.60 (80 per cent of 4.50) that the fare ledger's money block computes is not payable. The anti-farming check would not have withheld it in any event: 1 no-show termination against 129 completed trips in 30 days is neither 4 or more nor a rate above 0.08. POL-NS-12 cannot rescue the clock: this trip's arrival_marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO, and there is no wait_timer_expired event. POL-NS-03 does not apply either, because the driver's qualifying stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, not outside it. For the rider. Your own evidence does not help you, and you do not need it. The rider track in EV-GPS-02750 places your device 735.7 to 742.8 m from the pin throughout the window, so POL-NS-04 limb (c) is affirmatively failed; and the chat log holds only the driver's message, so limbs (a) and (b) — which require a locating or coordinating message FROM you — are not met. POL-NS-04 therefore does not exonerate you, and POL-NS-11 is not reached (your track is present and its fixes are not filtered for accuracy). But POL-NS-06 refunds the fee regardless of your presence, so the outcome is the same. Amount and integrity. The fare record is clean: the 4.50 cancellation-fee line reconciles with the 4.50 in force, total_charged is 4.50, payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged and there is no basis for splitting the amount. No two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; the 90-day counterparty-dispute counters are 0 on both profiles; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0; and the anti-farming check does not trip — so there is no escalation under POL-NS-09 and the fee is not held pending review. The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the 8.00 execution threshold and is released on issue. Confidence. The facts that decide the case — the 150-second dwell and the 180-second period in force — are carried by EV-GPS-02750 and EV-TRIP-02750, both at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and no discount applies; confidence is set at 0.90. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

What each side argued

The rider advocate

kept The waiting period can only be measured from the driver's own trace, and the trace gives him 150 seconds in the geofence — thirty short of the 180 seconds POL-NS-01(c) requires. The one in-geofence interval runs from 10:43:10 to 10:45:40 (16 fixes), and the driver cancelled at 10:45:43, three seconds after the run ends. Because limb (c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the 'arrived' tap, the 271 seconds between the 10:41:12 wait timer and the cancellation is not dwell time at all. Limb (c) fails and no no-show fee is chargeable.

evidence EV-GPS-02750, EV-TRIP-02750 · clauses POL-NS-01, POL-NS-06

kept On the face of the record the arrival limb fails too. POL-NS-01(b) requires the trace to place the driver inside the POL-NS-02 geofence at or before the timestamp of the 'arrived' event. The trace contains exactly one in-geofence interval and it begins at 10:43:10 — 120 seconds after the 10:41:10 'I'm Here' event. There is no qualifying fix at or before the tap, so the driver was not at the pin when he said he was; his own statement ('I pressed arrived a bit early') concedes the same.

evidence EV-GPS-02750, EV-TRIP-02750 · clauses POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02

kept This dispute resolves the same way on either reading of the marker, which is why the fee cannot survive. Take the 10:41:10 tap at face value and limb (b) fails, because no qualifying fix inside the 50 m STANDARD radius exists at or before it. Treat the marker as false and recompute the clock from the first qualifying in-geofence fix — which is what POL-NS-05 does and what POL-NS-01(c) requires in any event — and the dwell is 150 seconds, so limb (c) fails by the 30 seconds the derived block records as the shortfall. Either prong fails; neither leaves a chargeable no-show.

evidence EV-GPS-02750, EV-TRIP-02750 · clauses POL-NS-01, POL-NS-05

kept The driver's own message contradicts his own trace. At 10:41:30 he told the rider 'im at the pickup point' — the only message in the chat log — yet the trace's first qualifying in-geofence fix is at 10:43:10, one hundred seconds later. With the early-tap admission in the counterparty statement, that is a false arrival marker which does not start the waiting clock: on the recomputed basis POL-NS-05(i) refunds the fee in full with no compensation, and the false marker belongs in the ruling's referrals as a false-arrival event against the driver. The derived block carries no fix distance at the exact arrival timestamp, so I put the 300 m trigger to one side — the marker's falsity and the recomputed 150-second clock are established by the trace's own run structure and by the driver's admission.

evidence EV-CHAT-02750, EV-GPS-02750, EV-TRIP-02750 · clauses POL-NS-05

kept The refund is full, not partial: POL-NS-06 fixes this by arithmetic rather than judgement. Required minimum 180 seconds (the free_wait_sec in force for this trip, STANDARD class), measured effective dwell 150 seconds, shortfall 30 seconds — the derived block states the shortfall on that same basis, longest_run_sec. The clause refunds the cancellation fee in full, so the 4.50 line actually charged to the rider is returned whole.

evidence EV-GPS-02750, EV-TRIP-02750, EV-FARE-02750 · clauses POL-NS-06, POL-NS-01

kept The driver cannot make up the thirty seconds by summing intervals. There is only one in-geofence interval in the entire trace, and POL-NS-06(i) permits accumulation only across a second interval and only where a present and populated traffic advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT covers the pickup road. The advisory artifact here is MISSING: EV-ADVIS-02750-01 carries weight 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT — no advisory covers Blk 55 Lengkok Bahru in this window — so limb (i) is unavailable and nothing in it assists the driver. I cite the absence itself, not a document.

evidence EV-ADVIS-02750-01, EV-GPS-02750 · clauses POL-NS-06, POL-GEN-02

kept The driver cannot rescue the waiting period from platform telemetry either. POL-NS-12 applies only to an arrival established by GPS_AUTO with a platform arrival measurement stating distance and speed plus a wait_timer_expired event. This trip's platform_policy records arrival_marker BUTTON, the trip_record carries no wait_timer_expired event, and no platform arrival measurement exists. The 10:41:12 timer is the driver's own pressed marker and establishes nothing until the dwell behind it is verified — which it is not.

evidence EV-TRIP-02750, EV-GPS-02750 · clauses POL-NS-12, POL-NS-01

kept Nothing turns on where the rider's own device was. POL-NS-06 refunds the fee whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages; the deciding fact is the driver's dwell. For completeness, the rider_presence block (46 stationary fixes, 736 to 743 m from the pin, none inside the rider presence radius) cannot convert a 150-second dwell into a chargeable no-show, and the rider does not have to satisfy the POL-NS-04 coordination test to obtain this refund.

evidence EV-GPS-02750, EV-TRIP-02750 · clauses POL-NS-06

kept The sum to be returned is exactly 4.50 and the fare record is clean. EV-FARE-02750 shows a single cancellation_fee line of 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and that line reconciles with the 4.50 cancellation fee in force, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect and no basis for hedging with a split amount. Every artifact in the bundle is admissible at weight 1.0 apart from the MISSING advisory, so no discount applies to the facts that decide this case.

evidence EV-FARE-02750, EV-TRIP-02750, EV-GPS-02750 · clauses POL-NS-08, POL-NS-06, POL-GEN-02

kept No driver compensation is payable. POL-NS-07 pays the driver only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; POL-NS-06 displaces it here, so the sum the fare record would otherwise compute as the driver's 80 per cent stays unearned and the rider is not left funding a fee that never became chargeable.

evidence EV-FARE-02750, EV-GPS-02750, EV-TRIP-02750 · clauses POL-NS-07, POL-NS-06

kept Nothing here is undecided, and nothing justifies holding the fee instead of returning it. No two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; the 90-day counterparty-dispute counters are 0 on both profiles; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0; and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip — 1 no-show termination against 129 completed trips in 30 days is neither 4 or more nor a rate above 0.08. The correct and final disposition is FULL_REFUND of the 4.50 to the rider, not escalation under POL-NS-09.

evidence EV-RPROF-02750, EV-DPROF-02750 · clauses POL-NS-09, POL-NS-07, POL-GEN-03

The driver advocate

kept The driver did reach the pin, and POL-NS-02's geofence test is met on his own fix stream: the exported trace carries 80 driver fixes at a 10 second cadence with 100.0% coverage and no gaps, of which 16 qualifying fixes (reported accuracy of 25 m or better) fall inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, and the whole-track minimum distance from the pickup pin is 0.33 m. He was still inside that radius at 10:45:40, three seconds before he terminated the trip at 10:45:43. The rider's assertion that the app declared arrival while the driver 'was still far away on the main road' is therefore an assertion about the arrival marker, not about whether the driver ever came to the pin - on the fix stream, he did.

evidence EV-GPS-02750 · clauses POL-NS-02

kept The trip record terminates the trip by the driver at 10:45:43 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three codes POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises, and the record shows no boarding event and a null started_at. Limb (d) is therefore satisfied on the face of the record, and the driver's account - that he waited at the pin for a rider who never appeared - is the account the trip record supports. The code he chose was not a euphemism for a driver who could not find his rider.

evidence EV-TRIP-02750 · clauses POL-NS-01

kept The rider's own track is in the bundle and it places her nowhere near the pickup point: rider_qualifying_fix_count is 0 against the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius, and her device records a single stationary speed across the whole window at 735.7 m to 742.8 m from the pin (mean 739.1 m) from 10:39:29 to 10:46:19. POL-NS-04 limb (c) cannot be satisfied on this record - she was not inside the radius for the majority of the waiting window - so that rider-exonerating clause does not apply to her. And to the extent the zero count could be read as an accuracy filter rather than distance, POL-NS-11 is express that the test is then merely UNDECIDABLE, that POL-NS-04 still cannot exonerate the rider, and that the fee is decided on the driver's own arrival and dwell evidence.

evidence EV-GPS-02750 · clauses POL-NS-04, POL-NS-11

kept On the chat side the rider has no case under POL-NS-04 at all. The log holds exactly one message: the driver's 'im at the pickup point', sent at 10:41:30 and read by the rider at 10:42:00. The rider sent nothing during the waiting window. Limbs (a) and (b) of POL-NS-04 require a locating or coordinating message FROM the rider and then silence from the driver; with no rider message there is nothing for the driver to have failed to answer, and the trip record shows no in-app calls either. The rider never named an entrance, asked for the driver's position, or said she could not see the vehicle.

evidence EV-CHAT-02750, EV-TRIP-02750 · clauses POL-NS-04

kept The rider's complaint is about the arrival marker, and that is the question POL-NS-05 decides - arithmetically, on the fix at the marker's timestamp. That test cannot be run against the driver on this record: no fix at 10:41:10 is reported, and nothing in the bundle places the driver more than 300 m from the pin or travelling at 15 km/h or more at that moment. The driver's own statement - 'I pressed arrived a bit early but I did wait at the pin' - is an admission of an early tap, not of a fabricated arrival, and the fix stream then shows a stationary driver at the pin: minimum distance 0.33 m, still inside the 50 m radius at 10:45:40. On this record the false-arrival route to a refund, with its automatic referral item, is not established.

evidence EV-GPS-02750, EV-TRIP-02750 · clauses POL-NS-05

kept The dwell, stated as the record states it: the driver's effective in-geofence dwell under POL-NS-01(c) is 150 seconds - a single interval from 10:43:10 to 10:45:40, with dwell_start_offset_sec of -120.0 - against the 180 second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), a shortfall of 30 seconds. The driver does not dispute that figure and does not ask the tribunal to measure the period from his 10:41:10 arrival tap, which POL-NS-01(c) forbids. His submission on the same numbers is that the derived run is the conservative measure: a fix that fails POL-NS-02's 25 m accuracy filter counts as evidence of neither presence nor absence, so the 120 seconds between the tap and the first qualifying in-radius fix are neutral on this record rather than proof that he was away from the pin, and the platform's own wait-timer events record the free waiting period as starting at 10:41:12 and the termination at 10:45:43. If the tribunal takes the derived run as the effective dwell, the consequence is the one POL-NS-06 states - refund of the cancellation-fee line only - and no driver compensation.

evidence EV-GPS-02750, EV-TRIP-02750 · clauses POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02, POL-NS-06

kept The fare ledger offers the rider nothing beyond the cancellation-fee line: the ledger's cancellation_fee is 4.50, which is exactly the platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd in force for this trip, so the amount charged reconciles under POL-NS-08(d) and there is no fare-integrity defect to exploit; payment_status is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and the only line in dispute is the cancellation fee itself.

evidence EV-FARE-02750, EV-TRIP-02750 · clauses POL-NS-08

kept In the alternative, if the tribunal finds POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 per cent of the 4.50 net fee - 3.60, which is the figure the fare ledger's own derived money block publishes as driver_compensation - and the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4 the clause requires, and 1 over driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 129 is 0.008, below the 0.08 rate. Both limbs must hold for compensation to be withheld and neither does, so compensation is payable and, under POL-GEN-03, the ruling emitted on such a finding is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd mirroring 3.60.

evidence EV-FARE-02750, EV-DPROF-02750 · clauses POL-NS-07, POL-GEN-03

Dear Rider and Driver — the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02750 is refunded in full to the rider. No compensation is payable to the driver. Why the charge fails. The failure is on the waiting clock, not on whether the driver reached the pin. He did reach it: EV-GPS-02750 shows 80 fixes at a 10-second cadence, 100.0% coverage and no gaps, of which 16 qualify (accuracy 25 m or better) inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, in a single interval from 10:43:10 to 10:45:40, with a whole-track minimum distance of 0.33 m from the pin. But POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and NOT from the 'arrived' tap, and that interval is 150 seconds long. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). The dwell is 30 seconds short — the figure the derived block itself records — so POL-NS-06 makes the fee not chargeable and refunds it in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded to messages. The driver's submission that the 120 seconds between the tap and the first qualifying fix should be treated as neutral does not help: POL-NS-06(i) could only add separate intervals, there is only one in-geofence interval, and the traffic advisory that limb (i) requires is MISSING (EV-ADVIS-02750-01, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so limb (i) is unavailable and nothing in it assists him. The early arrival marker. The driver's own statement — 'I pressed arrived a bit early but I did wait at the pin' — is accepted as an admission that the marker was pressed before he was at the pin, and the trace agrees: the first qualifying in-geofence fix comes 120 seconds after the 10:41:10 tap, and the driver's 10:41:30 message 'im at the pickup point' is 100 seconds before that first qualifying fix. POL-NS-05's arithmetic trigger (more than 300 m from the pin, or 15 km/h or more, at the marker's timestamp) cannot be measured from the derived block, so the marker is not recorded as a false-arrival event; and the point would not change the money, because POL-NS-05(i) — the limb that applies where a recomputed clock falls short — also refunds the fee in full with no compensation. The rider's request for a false-arrival referral is refused: POL-NS-05(ii) and (iii), which are the limbs that carry that referral, do not apply, because the trace DOES contain a qualifying in-geofence interval (so limb (ii) does not fire) and the corrected dwell does NOT meet the minimum (so limb (iii) does not fire). The reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW was correctly selected, so POL-NS-01's driver-education referral for a mis-selected code is not engaged either. For the driver. The tribunal accepts that you came to the pin and held position there, and that limb (d) is satisfied on the record — RIDER_NO_SHOW is one of the three codes that limb recognises, with no boarding event and a null started_at. That is why this is a refund and not a finding that you fabricated an arrival. But POL-NS-07 pays you only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; POL-NS-06 displaces it here, so the 3.60 (80 per cent of 4.50) that the fare ledger's money block computes is not payable. The anti-farming check would not have withheld it in any event: 1 no-show termination against 129 completed trips in 30 days is neither 4 or more nor a rate above 0.08. POL-NS-12 cannot rescue the clock: this trip's arrival_marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO, and there is no wait_timer_expired event. POL-NS-03 does not apply either, because the driver's qualifying stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, not outside it. For the rider. Your own evidence does not help you, and you do not need it. The rider track in EV-GPS-02750 places your device 735.7 to 742.8 m from the pin throughout the window, so POL-NS-04 limb (c) is affirmatively failed; and the chat log holds only the driver's message, so limbs (a) and (b) — which require a locating or coordinating message FROM you — are not met. POL-NS-04 therefore does not exonerate you, and POL-NS-11 is not reached (your track is present and its fixes are not filtered for accuracy). But POL-NS-06 refunds the fee regardless of your presence, so the outcome is the same. Amount and integrity. The fare record is clean: the 4.50 cancellation-fee line reconciles with the 4.50 in force, total_charged is 4.50, payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged and there is no basis for splitting the amount. No two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; the 90-day counterparty-dispute counters are 0 on both profiles; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0; and the anti-farming check does not trip — so there is no escalation under POL-NS-09 and the fee is not held pending review. The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the 8.00 execution threshold and is released on issue. Confidence. The facts that decide the case — the 150-second dwell and the 180-second period in force — are carried by EV-GPS-02750 and EV-TRIP-02750, both at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and no discount applies; confidence is set at 0.90.
To the rider and the driver: the 4.50 SGD cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02750 is refunded to the rider in full. No compensation is paid to the driver. WHY THE FEE DOES NOT STAND. POL-NS-01 charges a no-show fee only where all four of its conditions hold, and two of them fail on this record. Limb (b) requires the GPS trace to place the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD pickup geofence at or before the 10:41:10 "I'm Here" tap in EV-TRIP-02750: the first qualifying in-geofence fix in EV-GPS-02750 is at 10:43:10, 120 seconds after the tap. Limb (c) requires a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least the free waiting period in force, 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec): the trace's only qualifying interval runs from 10:43:10 to 10:45:40, which is 150 seconds — a 30-second shortfall, stated in the trace's own derived block (shortfall_sec 30.0 on the longest_run_sec basis). THE DRIVER'S ARGUMENTS, ANSWERED. You are right that you reached the pin and stayed: the trace shows 16 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m radius and a whole-track minimum distance of 0.33 m, with you still in radius at 10:45:40, three seconds before you terminated at 10:45:43. But reaching the pin is not enough. The 271 seconds between your 10:41:12 wait-timer start and your 10:45:43 cancellation is not dwell time: POL-NS-01(c) measures the clock from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the tap or the timer. The 120 seconds before that first fix cannot be added back — a fix failing the 25 m accuracy filter counts as evidence of neither presence nor absence, and the dwell the clause measures still begins at 10:43:10. Your 10:41:30 message "im at the pickup point" (EV-CHAT-02750) does not extend it either. POL-NS-12 does not assist you: it covers only a GPS_AUTO arrival with the platform's own arrival measurement stating distance and speed, and this record shows arrival_marker BUTTON and no wait_timer_expired event. The limb (d) point (termination under RIDER_NO_SHOW, no boarding event) is accepted, but limbs (b) and (c) still fail, so limb (d) alone carries nothing. ACCUMULATING INTERVALS (POL-NS-06(i)) IS CLOSED. EV-ADVIS-02750-01 is MISSING — weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT — so no traffic advisory permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed, and the trace contains only one interval in any event. THE RIDER'S FALSE-ARRIVAL POINT, ANSWERED. POL-NS-05 makes an arrival marker false only where the GPS fix matched to the marker's timestamp puts the driver more than 300 m from the pin, or travelling at 15 km/h or more. The derived trace carries no distance or speed for 10:41:10, so that numeric test is not established and I do not record a false-arrival referral. Your underlying point is sound as far as it goes — the driver concedes he pressed arrived early, and the first qualifying in-geofence fix is 120 seconds later — but the concession and the run structure are not the clause's test, and the fee already fails without them. For the record, the export is silent on the driver's position at that exact second; that open question changes no money and so is not a referral. THE RIDER'S OWN POSITION (POL-NS-04 / POL-NS-11). The driver is right that your device shows 0 qualifying fixes inside the 100 m rider-presence radius and stays 736 to 743 m from the pin, so POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate you. That does not matter here: POL-NS-06 refunds this fee whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded, and the deciding fact is the driver's dwell, which fails. THE RIDER'S FALSE-ARRIVAL ROUTE AS A GROUND. Because the 300 m / 15 km/h trigger is not established, POL-NS-05(i) is not the route to this refund; POL-NS-01(c) and POL-NS-06 are. The arithmetic outcome is the same. NO DRIVER COMPENSATION. POL-NS-07 pays the driver only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. Limb (c) fails and POL-NS-06 states that where the dwell falls short the full refund stands and no compensation is payable. The 3.60 figure the ledger computes (80 per cent of 4.50) is therefore not reached, and the anti-farming check is not engaged because no compensation is earned. THE AMOUNT. 4.50 is the cancellation-fee line actually charged: EV-FARE-02750 shows cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and that line reconciles with the 4.50 fee in force, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect to correct. Nothing else was charged, so the whole line is returned. A partial refund has no basis: no deciding artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d) — no clock skew, no trace gap, no chat defect, no fare mismatch — and the only impaired artifact, the MISSING advisory at weight 0.0, carries no fact. Every artifact this ruling rests on (GPS trace, trip record, fare breakdown) is admissible at weight 1.0, so the confidence cap is 1.0. NO ESCALATION. I am above the 0.70 floor; no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; both profiles show 0 counterparty disputes in the trailing 90 days and rider no_show_disputes_30d is 0; and the anti-farming check does not trip (1 no-show termination against 129 completed trips in 30 days, neither 4 or more nor above 0.08). This ruling is provisional and may be appealed once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04. Its monetary effect, 4.50 SGD, does not exceed the 8.00 SGD execution threshold, so it executes automatically on issue.
To both parties, on trip TRP-02750. The charge is a cancellation fee of SGD 4.50, charged to the rider at 10:46 on 27 Aug 2026 and shown as the only line on the fare ledger (EV-FARE-02750: cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). It is refunded in full. Why the fee cannot stand. A no-show fee is chargeable only if the driver held position inside the pickup geofence for the whole free waiting period in force: 180 seconds for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, read off EV-TRIP-02750). The driver's qualifying in-geofence fixes run from 10:43:10 to 10:45:40 — 150 seconds — and he cancelled at 10:45:43, 30 seconds short of the 180 the clause requires (EV-GPS-02750, derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run 150 s, shortfall_sec 30 s). POL-NS-01(c) measures that dwell from the first qualifying GPS fix inside the geofence, not from the 'I'm Here' tap at 10:41:10, so the 271 seconds between the 10:41:12 wait timer and the cancellation are not dwell time. POL-NS-06 refunds the cancellation-fee line in full. Driver: the trace confirms you did come to the pin and stay there — 16 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD radius, closest approach 0.33 m, still inside the radius at 10:45:40 — and your chosen code RIDER_NO_SHOW is one POL-NS-01(d) recognises on a record with no boarding and a null started_at. Your statement that you 'pressed arrived a bit early but did wait at the pin' is accepted as far as it goes. But the waiting period is the consideration the fee pays for, and the record gives you 150 of the required 180 seconds. Your alternative argument — that the 120 seconds between your tap and your first qualifying in-geofence fix should be read as neutral rather than as absence — does not help: a fix that is neutral is still not dwell, and the clause measures a continuous qualifying run. Because POL-NS-06 displaces the charge, POL-NS-07 does not pay you the 80 per cent (SGD 3.60); compensation arises only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. The anti-farming check would not have withheld it (1 no-show termination in 30 days against 129 completed trips, so neither limb trips), but it is not reached.
